integrity: Full graph proven by mutually exhaustive coefficient split. The algebraic norm lemma is independently checked as a supporting finite-search mechanism. Finite experiments are corroboration, not proof. No independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies decimal one-digit edges for the standard initial pair and coefficients a>=2. A general Lucas termination theorem is already established by Kominers (arXiv:2512.06446, 2025); the norm cutoff in the proof is supporting analysis, not a separately claimed novel termination theorem. No classification for arbitrary bases, arbitrary initial values or multi-digit edges is claimed. No independent audit.
title: Complete decimal digit-extension graph for positive Lucas recurrences
